cov.title: Coverage: operator claims vs feeds
cov.sub: Cities listed on the operator’s website (as of {claims}) vs feeds of the last collector run ({run})
cov.none: No coverage in the data snapshot yet.
cov.noneHint: Appears with the next collector run (coverage.json).
cov.listOnly: only operators with a city list
cov.rateTip: {n} of {m} listed cities deliver vehicles in an open feed
cov.weak: List covers all of the operator’s services (incl. ride-hailing) – scooter service per city not confirmed
cov.namedNoData: Feed “{f}” names the city but delivers no vehicles there
cov.ambiguous: ambiguous place name ({n} municipalities) – largest chosen
cov.assumed: (per platform catalogue, city not confirmed individually)
cov.stray: + {g} fringe municipalities with {v} vehicles in total (operator only sporadic there: not on at least 3 days with 3 vehicles on average, no station)
cov.method: Categories: feed with vehicles = city listed and vehicles in the feed, feed without activity = source exists but has no vehicles (empty, gone, stale), feed not open = data only via a platform requiring access (e.g. MDD NRW), no feed = listed, no source, active, not listed = vehicles, but the city is missing from the operator’s list (often a neighbouring town in the same operating area), discontinued = source silent, city no longer listed. Fringe municipalities where the operator only runs sporadically (operating-area detection over 14 days; without it: under {min} vehicles) count as spill-over.
